subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should OpenClaw add a global `cron.defaults.delivery` primary delivery recipient default, and what precedence and safety rules should govern `announce`, `none`, `last`, account/thread routing, and `cron.failureDestination`?
rationale: The source gap is high confidence, but the requested fix adds a privacy-sensitive config surface and scheduled-output routing policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Add focused delivery default
options.body: Add `cron.defaults.delivery` with strict precedence, recipient validation, docs, CLI/UI support, and tests while keeping failure-notification defaults separate.

options.title: Fold into output routing
options.body: Defer the narrow default until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49078 decides channel, file, session, fallback, and status semantics.

options.title: Decline global default
options.body: Keep primary routing explicit per job and solve repetition through safer creation presets or documentation.

recommendation.title: Add focused delivery default
recommendation.body: Add `cron.defaults.delivery` with strict precedence, recipient validation, docs, CLI/UI support, and tests while keeping failure-notification defaults separate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest combined signal from prior triage and current cron/config history.
